design: Two backbones, same ordinary ACCORD library availability; no task-specific API hints, demos, recipes or prescribed method. Descriptive feasibility pilot, not tool-benefit experiment.
selection: Luna has passed prior reproduction tasks; Astra supplies a stronger-backbone comparator. Both available through authorized subscription, pinned Docker library stack.
budget_note: 900 seconds, 32 total execute/score calls, 5 development queries, 100k uncached-input+output and20k output. Cumulative/cache counters retained, no cumulative-token ceiling; checkpoint overshoot retained.
holdout_caveat: Public historical final period already inspected in prior experiments; not a fresh frontier-capability holdout. Final labels never mounted and final scores never shown during attempt.
decision_rules: Separate valid reproducible completion from final RMSE skill.
Compare final forecasts to fixed raw-model, seasonal-climatology and trusted correct-control scores.
Describe actual feedback trajectory and final candidate selection, including invalid requests.
No frontier-boundary claim from packaging/feedback failure or two descriptive attempts.
If feedback preflight fails, launch no inference; if pilot uncovers harness defect, stop additional model attempts.
No extra attempts automatically, no tuning controller comparator on final outcomes.
